# With a route_paths key, the hub's types are named by route_paths, not by the
# type names of a package entry. admin sets output_template_route_paths_type and
# its two siblings, muxt generate ignores them, the hub keeps the default names,
# and admin declares none of them (it may declare AdminPaths itself).

muxt generate
exists route_paths.go
muxt check
exec go build ./...
exec go test ./site ./admin

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
	"route_paths": {},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/admin": {
			"output_template_route_paths_type": "AdminPaths",
			"output_template_route_builder_type": "AdminBuilder",
			"output_template_route_type": "AdminRoute"
		},
		"example.com/m/blog": {}
	}
}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Dashboard() []int { return []int{42} }
-- admin/dashboard.gohtml --
{{define "GET /admin Dashboard()"}}{{range .Result}}<a href="{{$.Path.Blog.GetArticle .}}">article</a>{{end}}{{end}}
-- admin/own_test.go --
package admin

type AdminPaths struct{}
type AdminBuilder struct{}
type AdminRoute struct{}
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }
-- blog/article.gohtml --
{{define "GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)"}}<h1>{{.Result}}</h1>{{end}}
-- site/site_test.go --
package site

import (
	"net/http"
	"testing"

	"example.com/m"
	"example.com/m/admin"
	"example.com/m/blog"
)

func TestHubKeepsDefaultTypeNames(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	var paths m.TemplateRoutePaths = admin.TemplateRoutes(mux, admin.Server{})
	blog.TemplateRoutes(mux, blog.Server{})
	var adminPaths m.AdminTemplateRoutePaths = paths.Admin()
	_ = adminPaths
	if got, want := paths.Blog().GetArticle(7), "/article/7"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("paths.Blog().GetArticle(7) = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
